textures.purpose: Hexagonal ghost ring for a screen-space flare chain (optional, use sparingly: 0.05-0.15 opacity).
textures.worldScale: screen space, 3-10% of screen width

textures.purpose: Four-point star flare with faint diagonals, warm-white. Put one per light tower, scale up with camera distance.
textures.worldScale: 10-16 m billboard at the tower

textures.purpose: Anamorphic horizontal streak (cool blue-white). Night/rain stadiums, stacked on flare_star.
textures.worldScale: 30 m x 3.75 m billboard

textures.purpose: Soft round glow sprite (white RGB, falloff in alpha). Billboard over each lamp head / ball / sign; tint via material.color.
textures.worldScale: lamp halo: 14-20 m sprite; ball glow: 0.6 m

textures.purpose: Light-tower lamp head: 8x4 bulb grid in a dark housing. Use as map + emissiveMap (emissiveIntensity 2-4) so bloom catches each bulb.
textures.worldScale: whole texture = 8 m x 4 m lamp head (face the plate)

textures.purpose: Volumetric beam card/cone. Top row = lamp end (alpha high), fades to 0 at the bottom; soft across U. depthWrite=false, opacity 0.08-0.2 (more in fog/rain).
textures.worldScale: map onto an open cone or two crossed quads ~60 m long

textures.purpose: Steel lattice for light-tower legs: two rails + X bracing, transparent gaps.
textures.worldScale: 32 px = 1.2 m wide, one 128 px tile = 4.8 m tall

textures.purpose: Eight fake lofi ads (no real brands), backlit look. Use as map + emissiveMap (0.6-1.2).

frames.layout: row i = PNG pixel rows i*64..i*64+63 from the top (in GL UVs: v from 1-(i+1)/8 to 1-i/8)

textures.worldScale: one panel = 12 m x 3 m (outfield wall / upper deck fascia) or 4 m x 1 m (dugout rail)

textures.purpose: 4x4 tileable LED dot mask. In the screen shader: color = canvasColor * mask * 1.6, repeat so 1 tile = 1 canvas texel.
textures.worldScale: 1 tile = 1 LED (~6 cm on a 16 m board)

textures.purpose: Generic pixel scoreboard: steel bevel frame, 'LOFI BALLPARK' header plate, unlit LED screen. Draw live text into the screen rect with a CanvasTexture and multiply by led_mask.

screenRectPx.note: pixels from top-left of the PNG

textures.worldScale: whole board = 16 m x 8 m

textures.purpose: Outfield distance digits 0-9 in 12x16 px cells from x=0 (cells 10 = unused). White: tint via material colour.

frames.layout: digit d at pixel x = d*12 .. d*12+11; remaining 8 px on the right are empty

textures.worldScale: one digit ~0.6 m wide x 0.8 m tall on the wall

textures.purpose: Foul lines and batter's box chalk: chunky 4-texel-wide band of grey-white cells with worn (transparent) cells.
textures.worldScale: draw the line 0.12 m wide (4 rows = 3 cm texels); 64 px = 1.92 m along the line

textures.purpose: Infield skin dirt, base paths, batter's box area (red-brown cell mosaic).
textures.worldScale: 1 tile = 8 m (~6 cm per texel)

textures.purpose: Outfield/infield grass, no mowing stripes (stripe it in the shader). Mosaic of flat cells with short horizontal runs.
textures.worldScale: 1 tile = 8 m (~6 cm per texel); go up to 10 m for chunkier cells like the concepts

textures.purpose: Grass with baked mowing stripes: two bands (light, dark) running along V.
textures.worldScale: 1 tile = 16 m, so each stripe is 8 m wide

textures.purpose: Anti-tiling macro noise (R = main drift, G/B = extra independent octaves). Multiply ground albedo by mix(0.85, 1.12, r) sampled in world XZ.
textures.worldScale: 1 tile = 90 m (roughly the whole outfield); use G at 37 m for a second, uncorrelated layer

textures.purpose: Pitcher's mound and home plate clay (redder, packed, smoother).
textures.worldScale: 1 tile = 5 m

textures.purpose: Outfield wall padding, neutral grey: multiply by a team/stadium colour. Two 1.2 m panels per tile, cap seam at the top row.
textures.worldScale: 1 tile = 2.4 m wide x 2.4 m tall

textures.purpose: Warning track crushed brick/gravel along the outfield wall.
textures.worldScale: 1 tile = 6 m
